phase: Omitted phase keeps summary; phase:first_sample explicitly selects the separate first notification.
firstReviewSource: notification.source is derived from the first completed original check; use its revision/contentHash for existing expectedSummaryRevision/expectedSummaryHash field names.
independence: First sample and summary have distinct outboxes/message identities/reviews/once-only opt-ins. No automatic extra popup, grant or send. Existing Connectors are not expanded automatically.
firstEnable: First is blocked unless firstSampleWechat (or trusted test firstSampleAdapter) is separately configured/enabled and Connector declares its firstAction.
nativeBinding: After ORIGINAL successful code2session+reviewed membership+original Session login, the server privately remembers AppID/OpenID under that live Session. Public recipientBindings contains only id/revision/AppID.
clientReport: Challenge is Session/monitor/phase/AppID/template bound and single-use. Server verifies login/binding and records a fresh authenticated client report. It is NOT a signed or independently verified WeChat subscription credential.
platformFinal: Actual WeChat rejection is failed, refusal43101 revokes matching active evidence; unknown retains reservation without retry. Acceptance is not device delivery/read/business acceptance.
bootstrap: WORKSPACE_SUPPLIER_NOTIFICATION_CONFIG_FILE points to an existing absolute private JSON file: version1, wechat?, firstSampleWechat?, accessTokenFile?. Each adapter config supplies enabled/AppID/templateId/fields/page?/officialContractReviewed; mode is forced production.
tokenSnapshot: Existing absolute private accessTokenFile JSON contains appId/accessToken/expiresAt (epoch milliseconds). Reader pins AppID and rereads existing rotations. No mint/refresh/OAuth/grant/write occurs.
realVerification: Current official server pages remain inaccessible; officialContractReviewed defaults false. All current checks are local fixtures. No real token, grant, send, payment, deployment or seven-day acceptance.
frontend: Actual user gesture invokes wx.requestSubscribeMessage for server-provided template, reports selected decision and challengeId under the original native Session. Summary actions remain unchanged.
